description: Cornell Ithaca Campus heat use data for a model year is a data set deposited in DOE National Library of the Rockies (NLR) Repository by its authors Steve Beyers, J. Olaf Gustafson. Hourly steam use data for all significant buildings from the fiscal year (FY) 2017 (1 July 2016 - 30 June 2017) are provided. The total annual campus heating load in FY 2017 was about 0.81 trillion Btu (283,000 MWth-hrs). Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 2 files. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
